---
# CandidateLesson Record
# Generated by postmortem skill from incident analysis
#
# Fields:
# - id: Content hash of fingerprint+scope (stable identifier for deduplication)
# - failure_fingerprint: Unique signature of the failure pattern
# - evidence_references: Links to incident artifacts (postmortem, logs, tickets)
# - proposed_rule_text: New or updated rule text to prevent recurrence
# - proposed_gate_or_hook_change: Specific automation/hook change (if applicable)
# - scope: Where this applies (repo-wide, specific path, or cluster)
# - expiry: When this lesson should be revisited (ISO date or "never")
# - severity: Impact tier of this lesson (info/warn/crit)
# - status: Lesson lifecycle (candidate/active/expired)

id: "<CONTENT_HASH_OF_FINGERPRINT_PLUS_SCOPE>"
failure_fingerprint: |
  <UNIQUE_SIGNATURE_OF_FAILURE_PATTERN>
  Example: "deploy-without-test:service-X:missing-rollback-guardrail"

evidence_references:
  - postmortem: "<PATH_TO_POSTMORTEM.md>"
  - log: "<PATH_TO_RELEVANT_LOGS_IF_AVAILABLE>"
  - ticket: "<TICKET_ID_IF_APPLICABLE>"
  # Add other evidence types as needed

proposed_rule_text: |
  <NEW_OR_UPDATED_RULE_TO_PREVENT_RECURRENCE>
  Example: "All deployments to production must have a corresponding
  rollback plan documented and tested in staging."

proposed_gate_or_hook_change: |
  <SPECIFIC_AUTOMATION_CHANGE_IF_APPLICABLE>
  Example: "Add pre-commit hook that validates rollback plan
  exists in deployment manifest. Reject commits without it."

scope: "<SCOPE>"
# Scope examples:
# - "repo-wide" (applies to entire repository)
# - "path:deploy/" (specific directory)
# - "cluster:iad-ci" (specific cluster)
# - "service:api-gateway" (specific service)

expiry: "<EXPIRY_DATE_OR_NEVER>"
# ISO 8601 date for time-bound lessons: "2027-12-31"
# "never" for permanent lessons

severity: "<info|warn|crit>"
# info: Process improvement, low urgency
# warn: Important gap, should address
# crit: Serious safety hole, address soon

status: "candidate"
# candidate: Proposed, not yet adopted
# active: Adopted and enforced
# expired: No longer applicable

---
